title: Warn Console Log
summary: A Claude Code hook that warns the agent when an edit adds console.log to a JavaScript, TypeScript, Vue or Svelte file, so debug output is not left behind.
description: Debug prints have a way of surviving into commits. This PostToolUse hook looks at the text each Edit or Write call adds, and when it contains console.log it sends the agent a message with the file and the line numbers.
The file has already been saved, so the message works as a nudge, not a block. Test, spec and stories files are skipped, since logging there is often deliberate.
useWhen: Keep debug prints out of production bundles
Clean up after the agent traced a bug
Review front-end diffs with less noise
Push the team toward a real logger

hook.command: node -e "let d='';process.stdin.on('data',x=>d+=x).on('end',()=>{let j={};try{j=JSON.parse(d)}catch(e){return}const i=j.tool_input||{};const f=String(i.file_path||'');if(!/[.](js|jsx|ts|tsx|mjs|cjs|vue|svelte)[ ]/i.test(f+' ')||/[.](test|spec|stories)[.]/i.test(f))return;const t=String(i.new_string||i.content||'');if(!/console[.]log[ ]*[(]/.test(t))return;let n='';try{n=require('fs').readFileSync(f,'utf8').split(String.fromCharCode(10)).map((l,k)=>/^[ ]*console[.]log/.test(l)?k+1:0).filter(Boolean).slice(0,5).join(', ')}catch(e){}console.error('Warning: console.log was added to '+f+(n?' (lines '+n+')':'')+'. Remove it or switch to the project logger before finishing.');process.exitCode=2})"

example.prompt: Find out why the cart total is wrong.
example.result: The agent adds a console.log to cart.ts. The hook reports the line, and the agent removes the print once the cause is found.

faq.question: Is the edit undone?
faq.answer: No. The change is already written. The hook only tells the agent, which then removes the line on its own.

faq.question: Does it flag console.error or console.warn?
faq.answer: No. Only console.log is matched, because the other methods are often used on purpose for real error reporting.

access: Reads the edited text and then the saved file to find line numbers
Prints a warning and changes no file
